facts.fact: Tech in Africa describes a DRC digital transformation plan for 2026-2030 costed at EUR 8 billion (US$8.8 billion), with targets of 30,000 telecom towers by 2030, 650 communities connected and 250,000 youth trained (article date used, no event date given).

Tech in Africa says the plan is funded by a mix of public funds, international aid and private investment, with contributions from the DRC government, the World Bank, the EU and private firms (article date used).

systems.tiers: national; fibre, towers, data centres, digital government services, youth skills in AI, cybersecurity and programming
